content: Still of the Night A Spurloc Novel . Series (Spurloc) .  Spiurloc  has his work cut out for him, one night he receives a call from an old friend, someone who has, for years been able to stay one step ahead of Interpol who has been trying to  indite  the man for years on some of the most high profile burglaries in history. Now they have him dead to rights, but the problem  is ,  he didn’t do it so Spurloc now has to prove that the world’s greatest thief , is innocent. .  Idea Point This is an idea point, things I need to remember about the possible plot.  Hiro  Yakatashi Retired Art Collector and Master Cat Burglar Hiro is close to  retirement,  he is not as young as he used to be but before he can he is approached and the job is not one he can resist. He is Interpol’s most wanted and has been for years, no one has been able to catch the master thief and he is responsible for some of the greatest burglaries in history .  This time however he finds himself caught, setup as someone has sold him out. The irony  is ,  he never completed the job, with no one to turn to he calls an old friend Spurloc.
